description:
As a container specialist, you are managing microservices, each with its own INI configuration file. You are given an INI file at /home/user/services/payment_service.ini with various sections and keys. Your task is the following:

1. Extract the value of the database "host" and "port" used by the payment service. These values are under the [database] section within the /home/user/services/payment_service.ini file.
2. Write both values as a single line into a new log file at /home/user/services/payment_database.log, with the following format (separated by a colon, no additional whitespace):
host:port

For instance, if "host" is "db.example.com" and "port" is "5432", your log file should contain the single line:
db.example.com:5432

No other content should be present in the log file. Ensure you extract from the [database] section specifically.
truth:
The file /home/user/services/payment_service.ini is present with the following content:
[general]
service_name = PaymentService
timeout = 30

[database]
host = db.production.internal
port = 5432
user = payments
password = secret

[logging]
level = INFO

After correct execution, the file /home/user/services/payment_database.log should exist with the following exact content (and no preceding/trailing blank lines or spaces):
db.production.internal:5432
name: task_000000_2e009816
